variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Air Service Mag
variants.info:
Fit your M1903 Springfield with a specialty magazine used in aircraft.
These were used as survival rifles in the instances of soliders becoming stranded after a crash. Very large magazine capacity with the expected downsides...

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Pedersen Device
variants.info:
The M1918 Pedersen Device was an experimental conversion for the M1903 firing the .30-18 Auto cartridge. Replacing a majority of your M1903 Springfields parts to allow it to fire in semi-automatic. Feeds from a large 40 round magazine.

Incompatible with the Marksman Kit.
